name: Plyr
description: Integrates Plyr library as a video field formatter.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 Drupal integration for Plyr which is a simple, accessible and customizable media player for HTML 5 Audio, HTML5 Video, Vimeo and YouTube videos.

 
 Provide Plyr player field formatter for Drupal core's audio media bundle. 
 Provide Plyr player field formatter for Drupal core's remote_video media bundle. 
 Provide Plyr player field formatter for Drupal core's video media bundle. 
 
 Installation 
 Versions 8.x-1.x : Install as usual, see the official documentation for further information.

 Configuration 
 Example for Drupal core's remote_video media bundle:

 
 Go to Manage > Structure > Media types . 
 Edit Remote video . 
 Select Manage display tab. 
 Select Plyr for remote videos as format for field Video URL . 
 (Optional) Configure Plyr player options. 
 
 Try on simplytest.me 

 Requirements 
 Following Drupal core module is required to use Plyr module.

 
 drupal/media core module
